front.title: BGP CT - Adaptation to SRv6 and Other dataplanes

abstract.t:
This document specifies how the mechanisms for "Intent Driven Service Mapping" defined in [RFC9832] are applied to non-MPLS dataplanes. The extensions needed for SRv6 dataplane operations are specified. Base procedures of BGP CT are followed unaltered.
Illustration of how BGP CT procedures work in SRv6 dataplane is provided in this document.
